TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local effectController = EffectController() if effectController ~= nil then if effectController:CanPayManaCost("{1}") then effectController:BeginNewMultipleChoice() effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_OPTION_PAY_1" ) effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_DO_NOT_PAY_ONE" ) effectController:AskMultipleChoiceQuestion( "CARD_QUERY_MYRSMITH_DO_YOU_WANT_TO_PAY_1_AND_MAKE_A_TOKEN" ) EffectDC():Set_Int(0, 1) end end

local questionAsked = EffectDC():Get_Int(0) if questionAsked == 1 then local result = EffectController():GetMultipleChoiceResult() if result == 0 then MTG():PutTokensOntoBattlefield( "TOKEN_MYR_1_1_373734", 1, EffectController() ) EffectController():PayManaCost( "{1}") end end
